references.text: Balaam gives the same answer to Balak's servants as before—that he cannot go beyond the Lord's word, even if Balak fills his house with silver and gold.
Balaam confirms that he can only speak the word God puts in his mouth.
Balaam explains that he must speak what the Lord puts in his mouth.
Balaam repeats that he must do everything the Lord says.
The prophet Micah says similar words about speaking what the Lord tells him.
Peter refers to Balaam as one who loved the wages of unrighteousness, which contrasts with his statement here about not accepting wealth to go against the Lord's word.
